scripts.build: sh scripts/system32.sh && rm -rf dist && CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG=0 cargo +nightly build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p web --target-dir target/wasm && mkdir dist && cp target/wasm/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/web.wasm dist/
scripts.test: node --test scripts/next-version.test.mjs scripts/publish-feed.test.mjs scripts/prune-old-versions.test.mjs && tsx --test host/src/paths.test.ts
scripts.package: rm -rf plugin && mkdir plugin && cp -R dist/. host/dist/. plugin/ && cp web/src/audio-worklet.js plugin/ && cp -R system32 web/public/profiles plugin/
